US and Iran Set to Meet in Qatar for High-Level Talks

The US and Iran have announced plans to meet in Qatar for high-level talks, with no bilateral meeting confirmed. The meetings will be held at the technical level, and there are no direct negotiations planned between the two sides. The US delegation will include envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, while Iran has sent a delegation to Qatar for technical meetings.
